name: Oreb
overview: Oreb was a Midianite prince who was defeated by Gideon and killed at a specific location known as the rock Oreb east of the Jordan River, as recorded in Judges 7:25. This event is significant enough to be referenced in later Scriptures, such as Psalms 83:11 and Isaiah 10:26, where Oreb symbolizes the defeat of Midianite leaders by God's deliverance through Gideon. The narrative highlights God's sovereign power in delivering His people from their enemies and the tangible victory manifested in the death of Oreb at the rock bearing his name.
